permissionDenied.title: Ntibiboneka kuri uru ruhare rw'igerageza
permissionDenied.body: Uruhare rw'igerageza rwa {{role}} ntirushobora gufungura iyi paji. Iki gikorwa cyanditswe mu gitabo cy'igenzura.

notFound.title: Paji ntiyabonetse
notFound.description: Iyi aderesi ntihuye n'ipaji iyo ari yo yose muri iri gerageza.

routeError.title: Iyi paji ntiyashoboye kugaragara
routeError.description: Habaye ikibazo mu kugaragaza iyi paji. Ongera ugerageze, cyangwa usubize igerageza uko ryari riri ukoresheje Ibikoresho by'igerageza.

VALIDATION_ERROR.title: Reba ahagaragajwe
VALIDATION_ERROR.body: Hari amakuru abura cyangwa atari yo. Kosora ahagaragajwe hanyuma wongere ubike.

FORBIDDEN.title: Ntibyemewe kuri uru ruhare cyangwa iki kigo
FORBIDDEN.body: Aya makuru ari hanze y'uruhare cyangwa ikigo by'igerageza bikoreshwa. Iki gikorwa cyanditswe mu gitabo cy'igenzura.

NOT_FOUND.title: Amakuru ntiyabonetse
NOT_FOUND.body: Aya makuru ntabaho mu makuru y'igerageza, cyangwa yavanywemo no gusubiza igerageza uko ryari.

CONFLICT.title: Undi muntu yahinduye aya makuru
CONFLICT.body: Verisiyo nshya yabitswe ukiri gukora. Reba verisiyo iheruka mbere yo kongera kubika.

DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE.title: Serivisi ntiyashoboye kurangiza iki cyifuzo
DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE.body: Serivisi ikenewe kuri iki gikorwa ntiboneka. Nta kindi cyabitswe; ongera ugerageze.

OFFLINE.title: Nta murandasi
OFFLINE.body: Nta murandasi (kwiganwa) — impinduka ntizishobora kubikwa. Zimya iki kibazo muri Igenamiterere hanyuma wongere ugerageze.

TIMEOUT.title: Igihe cy'icyifuzo cyarenze
TIMEOUT.body: Igisubizo nticyageze. Bishobora kuba byabitswe — kongera kugerageza nta kibazo kandi ntibizabika kabiri.
